title: LVBT production platform manifest
description: Everything one app needs in production on Cloudflare and GitHub. `pnpm preflight --production` checks it; `pnpm bootstrap --production` sets up what is missing.

$schema.description: Path to this schema, for editor completion.

name.description: What people call the production site, such as lvwwd.org. Reports and token names use it.

d1.description: D1 databases the production Worker binds.

r2.description: R2 buckets the production Worker binds.

turnstile.description: Turnstile widgets, each feeding a site-key var and a secret on the Worker.

access.description: Cloudflare Access applications that put paths behind a sign-in, each feeding the team-domain and audience secrets the Worker checks.

email.description: Domains the Worker sends email from, with the DNS records their provider needs.

secrets.description: Secret values, on the Worker or in a GitHub environment. Values never appear in this file.

vars.description: Plain-text Worker vars that must be in the wrangler config's vars.

forbidden.description: Names that must never be set in production, as a secret or a var.

analyticsEngine.description: Production Analytics Engine dataset bindings; readiness compares repository and deployed Worker settings, without writing events.

rateLimits.description: Production Worker rate-limit namespaces and settings. Namespace identifiers share counters across Workers in an account.

name.description: An environment name in capitals, such as RESEND_API_KEY.

use.description: live: a feature people use today needs it, so production is not ready without it. future: only a feature that is not built yet needs it, so it can wait.

steps.description: Numbered, click-by-click steps to find or create the value. Write each as one complete sentence. Never ask for a second copy before the first is pasted; the last step copies this value for the prompt.

accountId.description: The Cloudflare account that owns the Worker and the zone.

accountIdEnv.description: Read the account ID from CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID at production check or setup time.

worker.description: The production Worker's name. It must match the wrangler config's name.

wranglerConfig.description: The production wrangler config, relative to this file. Defaults to wrangler.jsonc.

cloudflareConfig.description: The canonical cloudflare.config.ts project config, relative to this file. When set, preflight and deploy use cf instead of Wrangler.

domains.description: Public custom domains that must belong to the production Worker and declared zone.

environment.description: Explicit primary deployment mode for this manifest. Every Worker, binding, var and secret requirement refers to this mode; omission selects production.

migrations.description: The migrations directory, relative to this file. Every .sql file in it must be applied.

environment.description: Named deployment mode containing this binding. Omit for production.
Named deployment mode containing this binding. Omit for production.

name.description: The widget's name in the Cloudflare dashboard.

siteKeyVar.description: The var that carries the public site key. It must be listed in vars.

secret.description: The Worker secret that carries the widget's secret key. It must be listed in secrets.

name.description: The application's name in Zero Trust.

destinations.description: Host and path pairs such as example.org/admin and example.org/admin/*. A path does not cover the paths under it, and a wildcard does not cover its parent, so list both.

sessionDuration.description: How long a sign-in lasts, such as 24h. Defaults to 24h.

identityProvider.description: google-apps is Google Workspace; onetimepin emails a code.

allow.description: Who may sign in. Give exactly one.

googleGroup.description: A Google Workspace group address. Needs identityProvider google-apps.

emailDomain.description: Everyone with an address at this domain.

teamDomainSecret.description: The Worker secret that carries the Zero Trust team domain. It must be listed in secrets.

audienceSecret.description: The Worker secret that carries the application's audience (AUD) tag. It must be listed in secrets.

domain.description: The domain in the From address.

provider.description: The sending service. It decides which DNS records are checked.

dnsProfile.description: The DNS layout Resend shows for this domain. Defaults to the legacy SES MX/SPF layout; choose forge for Resend's rsend and send CNAME records.

region.description: The provider's sending region. Defaults to us-east-1.

apiKeySecret.description: The Worker secret that carries the provider's API key. It must be listed in secrets.

purpose.description: What production uses it for, in one sentence.

neededFor.description: The feature that stays broken without it, so the report can say so.

targets.description: Where the value is stored: worker, or github:<environment>. Defaults to worker.

url.description: The page to open first. Setup offers to open it.

generate.description: Setup mints a random value instead of asking for one.

sensitive.description: false for a value that is not a credential, such as an account ID, a team domain, or an Access audience tag. Setup then asks for it with visible input and shows its value in the report and its output. Defaults to true: the value is typed hidden and never shown.

from.description: Setup copies a value the manifest already knows.

pattern.description: A regular expression a pasted value must match.

patternHint.description: What a valid value looks like, shown when a pasted value does not match.

listOnly.description: Document a future requirement without creating or rotating a credential.

afterSet.description: Instructions for a maintainer to update an external consumer after every declared target holds the credential. Setup offers one explicit, default-off copy of the stored value.

repository.description: owner/name of the repository whose environments hold github: secrets.

variables.description: Required public repository Actions variables. Values may be compared, but setup never overwrites them automatically.

governance.description: Report organization governance using the shared policy; new requirements warn in 0.7.

environments.description: Release environments restricted to one selected branch, without changing existing reviewer or timer protections.

reason.description: Why it must not be set, in one sentence the report prints.

severity.description: error fails the check; warning only reports it. Defaults to error.

environment.description: The GitHub environment that owns this variable; omit for repository variables.
